headline: First uranium consignment arrives in Dhaka for Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant
summary: A cargo plane from Russia delivered the first batch of nuclear fuel, marking a critical step toward the plant's operational status.
details: The first cargo plane carrying nuclear fuel for the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant arrived at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka on Friday night.
The flight landed around 11:44 pm under international security guidelines, and unloading began immediately after arrival.
The Bangladesh Army will transport the nuclear fuel to the project site in Rooppur under special security arrangements.
Golam Mahbub, chief of administration of the plant, stated that nine flights are expected to deliver over 200 assembled fuel elements by December.
This delivery includes 163 assemblies for Unit-2 of the power plant.
Highway police have been instructed to ensure a clear lane and smooth transportation of the uranium convoy to the project site.
The first batch of nuclear fuel for Unit-2 had been previously postponed on September 24 due to a lack of airspace clearance.
caption:
Nuclear fuel has finally landed in Bangladesh. The first shipment of uranium from Russia has arrived in Dhaka.

The first cargo plane carrying nuclear fuel for the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant arrived at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka on Friday night.

The flight landed around 11:44 pm under international security guidelines, and unloading began immediately after arrival.

The Bangladesh Army will transport the nuclear fuel to the project site in Rooppur under special security arrangements.

Golam Mahbub, chief of administration of the plant, stated that nine flights are expected to deliver over 200 assembled fuel elements by December.

This delivery includes 163 assemblies for Unit-2 of the power plant.

Highway police have been instructed to ensure a clear lane and smooth transportation of the uranium convoy to the project site.

The first batch of nuclear fuel for Unit-2 had been previously postponed on September 24 due to a lack of airspace clearance.

headline: Ex-MP Major (retd) Akhtaruzzaman arrested over airport assault and disorder
summary: Jamaat-e-Islami has condemned the arrest of the former lawmaker, demanding his immediate and unconditional release.
details: Major (retd) Akhtaruzzaman, a leader of Jamaat-e-Islami and former Member of Parliament, was arrested by the Dhaka Metropolitan Detective Branch (DB) on Friday evening.
The arrest follows a case filed against him for allegedly obstructing government work, issuing threats, and creating disorder at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.

According to a statement by Jamaat-e-Islami Secretary General Mia Golam Parwar, Akhtaruzzaman returned to Bangladesh on October 1 after performing Umrah and faced harassment and suffering like other passengers.
The party claims that Akhtaruzzaman expressed his anger and demanded an end to the harassment at the airport, and that the case was filed before any investigation took place.
The statement further highlighted long-standing mismanagement and harassment at the airport's immigration, including unnecessary questioning, long waits, and disrespectful behavior toward passengers.
Jamaat-e-Islami has called for a neutral investigation into the complaints of harassment at the airport and demanded that those responsible be identified and held accountable.
The party has urged the government to release Major (retd) Akhtaruzzaman immediately and unconditionally, while ensuring better service quality and accountability at the airport.
